name: plutonium
description: Language support for the Plutonium systems language: highlighting, diagnostics, navigation, completion and formatting through pluto lsp

untrustedWorkspaces.description: pluto (the language server and pluto fmt) is not run in an untrusted workspace, and plutonium.plutoPath is read only from user settings there.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The language server and formatting run pluto on the local machine; highlighting works everywhere.

plutonium.plutoPath.markdownDescription: The `pluto` compiler, which runs the language server (`pluto lsp`) and formats Plutonium source. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; `~` and `${workspaceFolder}` are expanded.

plutonium.useLanguageServer.markdownDescription: Run the language server, `pluto lsp`, for diagnostics, hover, go to definition, references, symbols, completion, signature help, rename and formatting. When it is off, only formatting with `pluto fmt` is available.

plutonium.target.markdownDescription: The target the language server checks code for, which selects files by their `//pu:build` lines and file name suffixes. A file that the target leaves out is checked in the first build mode that includes it.

enumDescriptions: The target's default: hosted for x86_64-linux, freestanding for x86_64-none
No operating system, with the kernel mode rules
plutonium.mode.markdownDescription: The build mode the language server checks code in, as `pluto build --mode`.

plutonium.tags.markdownDescription: Additional build tags for the language server, as `pluto build --tags`.

plutonium.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the messages between VS Code and the language server to the *Plutonium* output.

plutonium.formatTimeout.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait for `pluto fmt` before giving up and leaving the document unchanged (used when the language server is off).
